text: 1269 fixes population that wrote into this.emailAddressesWithSecretKey while another event could clear that field during an await. Current code creates a local Set, awaits personal-key acceptance for each secret key, adds addresses to the local set and assigns it to the shared field at the end. A scoped recommendation is to retain the local construction target during this asynchronous population. There is no generation/cancellation guard here; this fix does not prove stale snapshots or concurrent refreshes are impossible. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Build an OpenPGP cache locally across awaits and publish it when complete
